title: Using AI to help with GRC tasks - do prompt structures matter?
content_md:
I'm both a CISO and a SaaS GRC tool founder, and from both angles I'm interested in how AI can help with some of the repetitive work. Like it or not, there's a strong push to find ways to use it, so I'd like to know how to do that effectively. NIST's draft SP 1353 (using AI for CSF 2.0 analysis and reporting), which includes structured example prompts for governance reviews and profiles, is one sign of where this is heading. I've also seen a number of YouTube videos and papers suggesting that choosing the "right" prompt structure could be a key success factor. I couldn't find any testing on GRC work specifically, so I pulled together the general research: Changing only the format (plain text, Markdown, JSON) can swing results a long way, but the best format doesn't carry over between model
